# Make HTML From Rich Text

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Creates an HTML document from the provided Rich Text.

## Syntax

~~~~text
htmlFromRichText(text: <#Variable (Optional)#>, fullDocument: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
htmlFromRichText(text: Rich Text, fullDocument: false)
~~~~
